title: Span coverage: clock, ranks, truncated steps
description: Which clock the worker sink stamped, how many ranks reported, and whether a step died mid-flight. `_launch` spans measure kernel launch rather than execution and must never be compared with `_wall`. A truncated step looks fast.

defaults.noValue: No spans at all. The run reported a policy_step, so the timing sink itself is not reaching finelog.

params.value: SELECT json_get(attributes_json, 'role') AS role, json_get(attributes_json, 'clock_domain') AS clock, COUNT(DISTINCT json_get(attributes_json, 'rank')) AS ranks, COUNT(DISTINCT json_get(attributes_json, 'step')) AS steps, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN json_get(attributes_json, 'outcome') = 'failure' THEN json_get(attributes_json, 'step') END) AS truncated_steps FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'phase_duration_seconds' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
